feature_name: Fix DateTime handling for millisecond timestamps
description: Fix a bug where DateTime fields return 'Invalid Date' when using unixepoch-ms (millisecond timestamps). Ensure that DateTime values are correctly parsed and returned as valid Date instances when reading from the database. Add comprehensive tests to verify the fix works across create, find, and aggregate operations.
functional_requirements: Fix DateTime parsing logic to correctly handle millisecond-precision timestamps (unixepoch-ms) from the database
Ensure DateTime values are returned as valid Date instances when reading records with millisecond timestamps
Add regression tests covering DateTime read/write operations with unixepoch-ms timestamps
Verify the fix works consistently across create, find, and aggregate query scenarios
Handle edge cases with large integer values safely to prevent precision loss
